_how: A story told on pictures. List the images once, then the text beats. Each picture carries 2 beats. Every beat has an English or Tanglish line and a Tamil line. No voice.

images.prompt: what the picture shows. Real people as inspired-by illustrations only: describe era, clothes, setting, not a name.

screens.line: The white line sets it up
screens.headline: THE GOLD LINE LANDS.

screens.line: The last line names a person
screens.headline: KNOW SOMEONE LIKE THIS?

count.shows: the number at {n} in the headline counts up; to, from, prefix, suffix

stamp.shows: one word stamped across the picture: stamp, at [x,y]

underline.shows: a line sweeps under the *starred* word

question.shows: the final beat, with the send pill
